title: Genesis
introduction: Genesis opens with God creating and ordering the heavens and the earth. Biblical History presents the passage alongside carefully qualified ancient cultural and literary context.

events.bookNote: Genesis 1:1–2:3 introduces the Bible’s account of creation and culminates in the seventh day. No independently established event date is assigned.

Genesis 2:4–3:24 tells a second, distinct creation account: the garden, the forming of the human, the command, the transgression, the judgments, and the expulsion. No independently established event date is assigned.
